description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git index-pack' and related pack file operations within a Git repository. It contains setup routines, test cases for different index versions, corruption checks, and verification steps related to Git pack files and index handling.

methods.name: index_obj_nr
methods.description: Returns the object number position within a pack index file for a given object SHA1 by parsing the pack index.

methods.name: index_obj_offset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset of a specific object within a pack file as indicated in the pack index.
